_meta.description: Policy y Peaches pollster grades. Leave-one-out par error on general-election polls matched to certified results, recency-weighted and shrunk toward the pool. Fitted by scripts/build_pollster_grades.py — do not hand-edit.
_meta.method: par_error = mean(|poll error| - |field error on the same race, excluding this poll|), time-to-election adjusted, half-life 4 cycles, empirical-Bayes shrinkage k=20 polls
_meta.scale: quality 0-3, 1.5 = par; grade = percentile of the graded pool
